推荐 Camera → IMU → Camera–IMU。Camera 与 IM: Recommended order: Camera → IMU → Camera–IMU. Camera and IMU can be done in either order; joint motion can be recorded first. Joint calculation needs camera parameters, IMU noise parameters, target geometry and a usable timeline from the same headband assembly. Optional joint-result review uses a separate recording. Read the reports before accepting any result.
建议静止录制至少 2～3 小时；可按需要调整，较短记录可能不足以估计长期噪声。点: For long-term noise analysis, aim for at least 2–3 hours of stationary data. You can adjust the duration; short records may not reveal long-term noise. Recording starts immediately.

固定标定板，移动整套头环。左右画面尽量持续看清板，做三轴旋转和少量平移。点击预览: Keep the target fixed and move the complete headband. With both parameter files present, calculation starts after recording. Otherwise, data is saved first: select the existing-recording workflow and add the two files later. Target geometry comes from the measurements on this page.
示例是 6×6 AprilGrid。尺寸填写你实际打印、测量的值，不能直接照抄示: The example is a 6×6 AprilGrid. Enter the dimensions you measured on your printed target. Do not copy the example blindly. The DS model does not require manual focal-length input.
计算和文件检查已完成。相机查看重投影误差与覆盖；IMU 查看连续性、静止条件及: Calculation and file checks are complete. For Camera, inspect reprojection errors and target coverage. For IMU, inspect continuity, stationarity and Allan curves. Generated files alone do not establish calibration quality.
“候选”表示检测到局部斜率，仍需复核；“未识别”不等于传感器损坏。完整候选 YA: Candidate means a local slope was detected and still needs review. Not identified does not mean the sensor is faulty. A complete candidate YAML requires evidence for all six axes.
用于复现旧联合标定试跑方式；不是正式噪声验收。保留逐轴斜率结果，不会补零或借用其: This reproduces the experimental joint-calibration workflow; it is not formal noise acceptance. Per-axis slope results are retained, without zero-filling or borrowing values from other axes. Dynamic residuals, timing and repeatability still require review.
Camera：相机标定；IMU：静止噪声分析；Camera–IMU：运动采集、已: Camera: stereo calibration. IMU: stationary noise analysis. Camera–IMU: motion recording, joint calculation and fixed-parameter review. Experimental results need review. Closing the browser does not delete data. Closing the launcher terminal stops the current task.

标定板放在画面中间，保持清晰；头环始终固定。: Keep the headband fixed. Place the target clearly in the centre of the images.
缓慢移动到左上、右上，让图案覆盖两幅画面的上方。: Move the target slowly to the upper left and upper right of both images.
缓慢移动到左下、右下，补充两幅画面的下方和边缘。: Move the target slowly to the lower left and lower right, covering the lower edges of both images.
让板向左、右、上、下倾斜，改变角度，避免只正对镜头。: Tilt the target left, right, up and down. Vary its angle rather than keeping it front-facing.
将板缓慢靠近、远离，兼顾近景和远景；尽量让两个镜头同时看到板。: Move the target slowly closer and farther away. Keep it visible to both cameras where possible.
补充尚未覆盖的边缘和倾斜角度，避免模糊、反光、弯曲。结束后自动计算。: Cover the remaining edges and tilt angles. Avoid blur, glare and bending. Calculation starts after recording.
标定板固定不动，拿稳整套头环，先保持静止。: Keep the target fixed. Hold the complete headband securely and start at rest.
缓慢左右摇头，再上下点头；让板在左右画面中清晰可见。: Rotate slowly left/right, then up/down. Keep the target clear in both images.
增加左右侧倾，改变旋转速度；不要只绕一个轴转动。: Add roll in both directions and vary the rotation speed. Do not rotate about only one axis.
轻柔组合旋转，附带少量前后、左右移动。避免抖动和运动模糊。: Combine smooth rotations with some forward/backward and sideways motion. Avoid shaking and blur.
保持板可见，逐渐恢复静止；板和相机/IMU的固定关系不变。: Keep the target visible and gradually return to rest. Keep the camera and IMU rigidly attached throughout.
